description.value:
Frequency once per patient per week

Trigger A willing patient of yours rolls a Runaway Mutation result on the Bloom Table.

When a patient rolls a Runaway Mutation, you may pick from two results instead of taking the one rolled.

Roll a second result on the Minor Mutation table alongside the one that triggered. The patient takes whichever of the two you choose, and the other is discarded entirely — it never happened, and doesn't count against anything. This doesn't let you avoid a Runaway Mutation happening at all, only steer which one lands.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Also No Reroll rule-element key exists anywhere in the compendium, and no rule element rerolls or lets a player choose between two results of a homebrew table. -- rolling a second Bloom Table result and keeping either is directly a reroll/pick-of-two mechanic on a homebrew table.
